column1: # VTS CO2-SENS-D-MODRTU Modbus register map - easymodbus.com - source: https://www.vtsgroup.com/files/document-files/3430/CO2_EN_2.0.pdf

column15: 0 = Sensor missing; 1 = Correct operation; 2 = Sensor error; 3 = Warm up (first 3 minutes after start)

column7: Always 1000 (0x03E8); use it to check reads are correct.
Write 1234 (0x04D2) to execute the command in COMMAND_REG/PARAM_REG.
Command number; reads 0xEEEE after an invalid parameter.
column15: 1 = Set device address; 2 = Set baud rate; 3 = Set parity; 4 = Set stop bits; 5 = ABClogic on/off; 6 = Device reset

column7: Parameter for the command; see notes for the value list per command.

column15: bit 0-1 = T: type (0 duct, 1 room); bit 2-3 = Always 0; bit 4-8 = OPTIONS: device type (b10000 = CO2 transducer with MH-Z19B); bit 9-10 = HV: hardware version; bit 11-15 = DEV: b11000 = air parameter sensor

column7: Four nibbles N.AB + revision letter, e.g. 0x3210 = 3.21a.
column15: bit 0-3 = REV: revision letter (0 = a ... 9 = j); bit 4-7 = B digit; bit 8-11 = A digit; bit 12-15 = N digit
